subtitulo: Marketing emails. Everyone who confirms their account joins the audience and starts the welcome journey. The key is stored encrypted; anything you don't set here comes from the server's .env.
ayudaActivo: New sign-ups join the audience and every uploaded video sends an event.
ayudaApagado: Nothing is sent to Mailchimp: the key or the audience is missing.

clave.reemplazar: Paste a new key to replace it
clave.donde: In Mailchimp: Profile → Extras → API keys. It ends with the data center (…-us15).

journey.ayuda: A journey whose starting point is "API trigger": it starts when someone confirms their account. Paste the trigger URL Mailchimp gives you or type journey/step (35/99).
journey.sin: No journey: only the se_registro event is sent.
journey.noActivo: Until it's active in Mailchimp, new sign-ups don't enter the journey.
journey.confirmarQuitar: Remove the journey? New sign-ups stop entering it (unless the .env has one).
